title: DNA Separation and Detection on Agarose Gels
author: LI-COR Biosciences
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.q92dz8e

steps.title: Cast agarose gel with comb
steps.instruction: Prepare agarose at the desired concentration (e.g., 0.8%, 1.0%, 1.2%) in 1X TAE or 1X TBE, heat until fully dissolved, cool the solution to about 60 °F (warm to the touch), pour into a casting tray, insert the comb, allow the gel to solidify, then remove the comb and place the gel in a buffer tank.

substeps.instruction: Mix agarose powder with 1X TAE or 1X TBE to achieve the chosen % (0.8%, 1.0%, 1.2%, etc.).
Heat the mixture until the agarose is completely dissolved.
Cool the molten agarose until it feels warm to the touch (~60 °F).
Pour the cooled agarose into the casting tray and set the comb in place.
Remove the comb and transfer the gel into a buffer tank.

steps.title: Prepare electrophoresis buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare enough 1X TAE or 1X TBE buffer to fill the electrophoresis apparatus.

steps.title: Prepare DNA samples with loading dye
steps.instruction: Mix each DNA sample with an appropriate loading buffer and load the mixtures into the wells of the solidified agarose gel.

steps.title: Prepare staining solution
steps.instruction: Make a sufficient volume of 1X TAE or water to cover the gel, then add either ethidium bromide or SYBR Safe as follows: add 5 µL of 10 mg/mL EtBr stock to 100 mL buffer (final 0.5 µg/mL) **or** add 10 µL of 10,000X SYBR Safe stock to 100 mL buffer (final 1X).

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL of 10 mg/mL ethidium bromide stock to 100 mL of 1X TAE or water (final concentration 0.5 µg/mL).
Add 10 µL of 10,000X SYBR Safe stock to 100 mL of 1X TAE or water (final concentration 1X).

steps.title: Stain gel
steps.instruction: Submerge the gel in the prepared staining solution for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Destain gel
steps.instruction: Place the gel in fresh water for 20 minutes; repeat the destaining step as needed to eliminate background fluorescence.

steps.title: Image gel on Odyssey
steps.instruction: Capture the gel image using the Odyssey Fc Imager on the 600 nm channel, following the instrument’s Image Acquisition protocol for further details.
